paragraphs: We are a commercial-stage company with a late-stage pipeline committed to redefining what is possible in bringing life-changing therapies to people living with rare diseases. We are focused on expanding patient access, progressing our pipeline toward key milestones, and delivering meaningful therapeutics. Our vision is realized through disciplined execution of our strategic plan and our core values — patient centricity, integrity, accountability, innovation, and courage — which guide our efforts to deliver long-term value. The commercialization of our lead product, marketed in the United States for Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC), a rare, progressive neurodegenerative disease, provides a strong corporate foundation and demonstrates our ability to advance therapies from development to market.

In February 2023, we changed our name to Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. Zevra, is the Greek word for zebra, which is the internationally recognized symbol for rare disease. This name reflects our intense focus and dedication to developing transformational, patient-focused therapies for rare diseases with limited or no treatment options available, or treatment areas with significant unmet needs.

Our strategic plan is focused on transforming Zevra into a leading rare-disease company. We are prioritizing the commercialization and global expansion of our lead product, MIPLYFFA, while OLPRUVA remains commercially available. We are also advancing the development of our clinical stage asset, celiprolol, and plan to further expand our pipeline through inorganic growth. We intend to become the preferred partner for assets that we believe will allow us to leverage the expertise and infrastructure that we have built to help mitigate risk and enhance our probability of success.

In May 2022, we purchased all of the assets and operations of Orphazyme A/S ("Orphazyme") related to arimoclomol. On September 20, 2024, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") approved the New Drug Application ("NDA") for MIPLYFFA, for use in combination with miglustat for the treatment of neurological manifestations of NPC in adult and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older, and MIPLYFFA became commercially available for dispense in the United States in November 2024. In connection with this approval, we received a transferable rare pediatric disease priority review voucher ("PRV"). On April 1, 2025, we consummated the sale of the PRV, resulting in net proceeds of $148.3 million to us. MIPLYFFA has also been granted orphan medicinal product designation for the treatment of NPC by the European Commission. We are pursuing regulatory approval in E.U. and filed a Marketing Authorization Application ("MAA") with the European Medicines Agency ("EMA") in July 2025; the application is currently under review.

On November 17, 2023, we completed the acquisition of Acer Therapeutics, Inc. ("Acer"), pursuant to which Acer became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Zevra. This included the acquisition of OLPRUVA (sodium phenylbutyrate) for oral suspension, which is commercially available in the U.S., for the treatment of certain urea cycle disorders ("UCDs"). In addition, we acquired Acer's pipeline of investigational product candidates, including celiprolol for the treatment of Vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (VEDS) in patients with a confirmed type III collagen (COL3A1) mutation. We are actively enrolling a Phase 3 clinical trial, known as DiSCOVER, to determine whether celiprolol reduces the risk of clinical events in patients with VEDS.

We have built a diverse portfolio of products and product candidates through a combination of internal development and strategic investments through acquisition. For example, we employed our proprietary Ligand Activated Technology (LAT) platform to develop approved product AZSTARYS. Through our business development efforts, we have added commercial products (MIPLYFFA and OLPRUVA), and a clinical development candidate (celiprolol).
Current commercial products and active development assets are summarized in the table below:

Sodium phenylbutyrate Urea Cycle Disorders (UCD) OLPRUVA FDA Approval: Dec. 22, 2022; IP through 2036
Celiprolol Vascular Ehlers Danlos Syndrome (VEDS) Celiprolol Clinical - Phase 3 trial ongoing; IP potential through 2038
Serdexmethylphenidate Idiopathic Hypersomnia (IH) KP1077IH Clinical - Phase 3 trial ready; IP potential through 2038
Serdexmethylphenidate Narcolepsy KP1077N Clinical - Phase 3 trial potential; IP potential through 2038

headings: Risks Related to the Commercialization of Our Approved Products and Product Candidates
Failure to obtain or maintain coverage and adequate reimbursement for our products could limit our ability to market those products and decrease our ability to generate revenue.
We face substantial competition, which may result in others developing or commercializing products before or more successfully than we do.
We may be subject to enforcement action if we engage in improper marketing or promotion of our products.
Product liability lawsuits against us could cause us to incur substantial liabilities and to limit commercialization of our approved products, or any of our product candidates that we may develop.
Significant political, trade, regulatory developments, and other circumstances beyond our control could delay, prevent or impair our development or commercialization efforts.
Any side effects or adverse events caused by approved products following regulatory approval, could result in a number of potentially significant negative consequences.
A variety of risks associated with marketing our approved products and any of our product candidates, if approved, internationally, could affect our business.
Risks Related to Our Business and Our Financial Position
We are highly dependent on one product for substantially all of our revenues, and any loss of revenue from this product could materially harm our business.
We might not be able to utilize a significant portion of our net operating loss carryforwards, which could adversely affect our profitability.

We recognized an impairment charge related to intangible assets. If our remaining assets become impaired in the future, we would incur additional impairment charges, which would negatively affect our operating results.
Risks Related to Our Dependence on Third Parties
We rely on a limited number of suppliers, in some cases sole-source suppliers.
We rely on and expect to continue to rely on third parties to conduct our clinical trials for our product candidates, and those third parties may not perform satisfactorily.
We may seek to establish collaborations for certain product candidates, which may not be available on acceptable terms, or at all.
Risks Related to Our Intellectual Property
We may become involved in lawsuits to protect or enforce our patents or other intellectual property, which could be expensive, time consuming and unsuccessful.

Third parties may initiate legal proceedings against us alleging that we are infringing their intellectual property rights, the outcome of which would be uncertain and could significantly harm our business.
Intellectual property litigation could cause us to spend substantial resources and distract our personnel from their normal responsibilities.
If we are unable to protect the confidentiality of our trade secrets, our business and competitive position would be harmed.
Any trademarks we may obtain may be infringed or successfully challenged, resulting in harm to our business.
We may not be able to protect our intellectual property rights throughout the world.
Risks Related to Regulatory Approval of Our Product Candidates and Other Legal Compliance Matters

If we are not able to obtain required regulatory approvals for any of our product candidates, we will not be able to commercialize them and our ability to generate revenue or profits could be limited.
paragraphs: If we are unable to establish effective sales, marketing and distribution capabilities for our approved products, including any of our product candidates that may receive marketing approval, we may not be successful in commercializing such products in the United States or any other jurisdictions.

We currently have limited marketing and sales experience. In order to commercialize our approved products, we have added marketing, sales, medical affairs, distribution, managerial and other non-technical capabilities, or have made arrangements with third parties to perform these services. For any of our other product candidates that receive marketing approval, we may have to augment our commercial capabilities or make arrangements with third parties to perform additional services. Building and maintaining a targeted specialty sales force is expensive and time consuming. Any failure or delay in the development of our internal sales, marketing and distribution capabilities would adversely impact our commercialization efforts. We may choose to collaborate with third parties that have their own sales forces and established distribution systems, in lieu of or to augment any sales force and distribution systems we may create. If we are unable to enter into collaborations with third parties for the commercialization of approved products on acceptable terms or at all, or if any such collaborator does not devote sufficient resources to the commercialization of our products or otherwise fails in commercialization efforts, we may not be able to successfully commercialize our approved products.

Our approved products, as well as any of our product candidates that may receive marketing approval, may fail to achieve the degree of market acceptance by physicians, patients, third-party payors and others in the medical community necessary for commercial success.

Our approved products, as well as any of our product candidates that may receive marketing approval, may fail to gain sufficient market acceptance by physicians, patients, third-party payors and others in the medical community. paragraphs: 本公司為一家商業階段公司，擁有晚期臨牀階段產品管線，致力於重新定義為罕見疾病患者帶來改變生命的療法的可能性。本公司專注於擴大患者可近性、推動產品管線達成關鍵里程碑，並提供具意義的治療方案。我們的願景透過嚴謹執行戰略計畫與核心價值觀—以患者為中心、誠信、責任、創新與勇氣—來實現，這些價值觀引導我們努力提供長期價值。我們領先產品MIPLYFFA在美國上市，用於治療尼曼匹克症C型（NPC），一種罕見且進行性神經退化性疾病，為本公司奠定堅實的企業基礎，並展現我們將療法從開發階段推進至市場的能力。
2023年2月，本公司將公司名稱更名為Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. Zevra是希臘語中「斑馬」的詞，為國際上認可的罕見疾病象徵。這個名稱反映我們對開發具變革性、以患者為中心的治療方案的強烈專注與承諾，針對罕見疾病，這些疾病目前缺乏治療選擇，或治療領域存在顯著未滿足的醫療需求。
我們的戰略計畫聚焦於將Zevra轉型為一家領導的罕見疾病公司。我們優先推動領先產品MIPLYFFA的商業化與全球擴張，同時OLPRUVA仍持續商業化。我們也正在推進臨牀階段資產celiprolol的開發，並計畫透過無機成長進一步擴展產品管線。我們意圖成為那些我們認為能讓我們利用已建立的專業知識與基礎設施，以降低風險並提高成功機率的資產的首選合作夥伴。

2023年11月17日，我們完成對Acer Therapeutics, Inc.（"Acer"）的收購，Acer成為Zevra的全資子公司。此交易包含取得OLPRUVA（sodium phenylbutyrate）口服懸浮液，此產品已在美國商業化，用於治療某些尿素循環疾病（"UCDs"）。此外，我們也取得Acer的臨牀前產品候選品項，包括celiprolol，用於治療具有確認III型膠原蛋白（COL3A1）突變的血管型埃爾德氏症候羣（VEDS）。我們正在積極招募參與第三期臨牀試驗，名為DiSCOVER，以評估celiprolol是否能降低VEDS患者臨牀事件的風險。
我們透過內部開發與戰略投資收購，建立了一個多元化的產品與產品候選品項組合。例如，我們運用專利的Ligand Activated Technology（LAT）平台開發已核准產品AZSTARYS。透過我們的業務發展努力，我們已增加商業產品（MIPLYFFA與OLPRUVA），以及一個臨牀開發候選品項（celiprolol）。
目前商業化產品與積極開發資產的總結如下：
Arimoclomol 尼曼匹克症C型（NPC） MIPLYFFA 美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准：2024年9月20日；罕見藥物獨佔權（"ODE"）至2031年
擴展存取計畫 ("EAP") 製藥許可申請 ("MAA") 正在審查中，於 2025 年 7 月 28 日提交

西利普羅洛爾 血管型埃爾德爾斯-丹洛斯症候羣 (VEDS) 西利普羅洛爾 臨牀 - 第 3 期試驗進行中；智慧財產權潛在至 2038 年
塞德克西甲基苯丙胺 原發性過度嗜睡症 (IH) KP1077IH 臨牀 - 第 3 期試驗準備就緒；智慧財產權潛在至 2038 年

paragraphs: 你應閱讀以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果之分析，並與我們財務報表及其相關附註一併參考，這些內容包含於本年度報表（Form 10-K）之其他部分。部分資訊包含於本討論與分析或本年度報表（Form 10-K）其他部分，包括有關我們業務與相關融資之計畫與策略，包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。由於許多因素，包括本年度報表（Form 10-K）「風險因素」部分所列因素，我們實際結果可能與預測性陳述中所述或暗示之結果有重大差異。

我們是一家商業階段公司，擁有晚期臨牀階段產品組合，致力於重新定義為罕見疾病患者提供改變生命的治療方案之可能性。我們專注於擴大患者取得治療之管道、推動產品組合達成關鍵里程碑，並提供具意義之治療方案。我們的願景透過我們戰略計畫之嚴謹執行與我們的核心價值觀——以患者為中心、誠信、責任、創新與勇氣——來實現，這些價值觀引導我們努力提供長期價值。我們領先產品之商業化，該產品在美國用於治療尼曼匹克症 C 型（NPC），一種罕見、進行性神經退化性疾病，為本公司奠定堅實基礎，並展現我們將治療方案從開發階段推進至市場之能力。
2023 年 2 月，我們將公司名稱更名為 Zevra Therapeutics, Inc. Zevra 是希臘語中「斑馬」之意，為國際上罕見疾病之象徵。此名稱反映我們對開發改變性、以患者為中心之治療方案之強烈專注與承諾，針對罕見疾病，這些疾病目前缺乏治療選擇，或治療領域有顯著未滿足之需求。
我們的戰略計畫聚焦於將 Zevra 轉型為領導罕見疾病領域之公司。我們優先推動領先產品 MIPLYFFA 之商業化與全球擴張，同時 OLPRUVA 仍可商業化。我們亦在推動臨牀階段資產 celiprolol 之開發，並計畫透過非營利性成長進一步擴展產品組合。我們意圖成為我們認為可讓我們利用已建立之專業知識與基礎設施，以降低風險並提高成功機率之資產之首選合作夥伴。

2024 年 9 月 20 日，美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）批准 MIPLYFFA 之新藥申請（"NDA"），用於與 miglustat 組合治療 NPC 之神經表現於成人及 2 歲以上之兒童，MIPLYFFA 於 2024 年 11 月成為美國可商業化之產品。配合此批准，我們獲得可轉讓之罕見兒童疾病優先審查憑證（"PRV"）。2025 年 4 月 1 日，我們完成 PRV 之出售，為本公司帶來淨現金流入 148.3 百萬美元。MIPLYFFA 亦已獲得歐盟委員會針對 NPC 治療之罕見藥物產品指定。我們正在追求歐洲之監管批准，並於 2025 年 7 月向歐洲藥物管理局（"EMA"）提交市場許可申請（"MAA"）；該申請目前正進行審查。

2023 年 11 月 17 日，我們完成對 Acer Therapeutics, Inc.（"Acer"）之收購，Acer 成為 Zevra 之 wholly-owned subsidiary。此收購包含取得 OLPRUVA（sodium phenylbutyrate）口服懸浮液，該產品於 2022 年 12 月 27 日獲 FDA 批准，用於治療某些尿素循環疾病（"UCDs"）。此外，我們亦取得 Acer 之臨牀階段產品候選品組合，包括 celiprolol 用於治療血管型 Ehlers-Danlos 綜合症（VEDS）之患者，這些患者經確認有 type III collagen（COL3A1）基因突變。

我們在營運歷史上曾有持續之負淨營運現金流，我們無法保證或預測我們何時可能開始持續產生正淨營運現金流，或是否能實現。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日之年度，營運活動所使用之現金為（1.6）百萬美元及（69.7）百萬美元。我們預期將持續產生重大費用及營運活動之微小正淨現金流或負淨現金流，且這些費用與虧損可能在季度與年度之間大幅波動。我們預期費用將大幅波動，因我們：
•持續建立與維護我們之商業能力，以支持我們已核准產品 MIPLYFFA 與 OLPRUVA 在美國之商業化；
•持續或啟動臨牀前研究、臨牀試驗及產品開發活動，以進行我們產品候選藥物的研發；
•尋求對任何可能成功完成臨牀試驗的產品候選藥物進行監管審批；
•尋求發現、授權或取得，並開發更多產品候選藥物；
•調整我們的監管合規努力，以符合已上市產品的相關要求；
•維持、擴充並保護我們的智慧財產權組合；
•因作為上市公司運作而產生額外的法律、會計及其他費用；

headings: 與我們核准產品及產品候選品商業化相關的風險
未能取得或維持對我們產品的保險覆蓋及足夠的補償，可能會限制我們推廣這些產品的能力，並降低我們產生收入的能力。
